research.title: CVE-2026-72898 | Metabase Pre-Authentication SQL Injection Vulnerability
research.summary: CVE-2026-72898 is a critical unauthenticated SQL injection vulnerability in Metabase, a widely used open-source business intelligence and data analytics platform. Successful exploitation can give an attacker administrator access to the affected Metabase.

research.title: What 50 open source projects taught us about security in the AI era
research.summary: AI is changing the pace of open source development and the security challenges that come with it. Maintainers are reviewing unfamiliar contributions, managing new attack surfaces, and responding to vulnerabilities with limited time and resources. Session 4.
